suite: Dollar Shave Club CXAS Multi-turn Scenarios

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Hi, I'm new to Dollar Shave Club and want to try a razor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Welcome user and introduce the $5 Starter Kit offer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: I shave about 3 times a week and have sensitive skin.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Recommend Shave Butter and suggest an ongoing refill frequency of every 3 months.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Sounds good, where do I sign up?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Provide direct link to #starter-set with $5 offer code.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: I'm going on vacation for two months and have too many blades.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Recognize surplus inventory; explain how to skip a shipment or delay next delivery date.

turns.speaker: user
turns.utterance: Can I do that without canceling my membership?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.expected_behavior: Confirm yes, membership remains active with free shipping intact.
